decision.conclusion: 两个比较均没有新增低响应实际匹配；本轮未建立 M1 的历史恢复能力。
decision.scope: Conservative evidence classification for this paired128-step run, not novelty/generalization or permanent feasibility judgment
decision.next_action: No automatic continuation, Frame control, added loss, new mechanism or M2; final interpretation is reviewed by the project owner

protocol.single_change: A=PDA(previous,X); R=TSFM(A,X); supplied core M=(1-g)R+gA; M0=X0

endpoint_interpretation.boundary: Observable effect chain at this endpoint, not a proof of the unique failure cause; no Frame control was run

continuity.scope: Frozen strict5200 target frames on130 tracks; valid annotated strict intervals, not all16297 GT or full physical visibility
continuity.main_continuity_cohort: all; low/extreme filtering can introduce new breaks and is not used as the main continuous-time claim

mechanism.scope: t>0; overlap-window average per object/arrangement, equal available O/S then target-frame equal weighting; t0 has no gate
mechanism.quantiles: Gate q05/q50/q95 are averages of ROI/frame quantiles, not quantiles of pooled pixels
mechanism.background_scope: Fixed release-selected same-size hard background per target; repeated physical regions are not independent samples
mechanism.stage_semantics: after_tsfm is bare R; after_update is actual M=(1-g)R+gA; same-History delta=history-current_only
mechanism.t0_and_time_offsets: Separate full tables retained in trace_summary; offset populations change, no causal memory-decay rate inferred

fixed_training_calibration.weighting: Equal mean across8 fixed training entries; each source readout internally counts cached observations with multiplicity
fixed_training_calibration.scope: Training calibration only; no development matching, no thresholded recovery claim; 0/32/64 are process records, final128 fixed

cost.scope: Inference includes3-mode shared-front-end trace, ROI/Jacobian statistics and serialization; not deployment latency. Memory is peak allocated, not reserved.

reference.RFR: Unchanged pinned PDA/TSFM and real DCN from m1_recurrent_v1/upstream
reference.state_update: Unmodified user reference core; 2017 parameters; no mask/BN/detach; g is retention, not calibrated uncertainty
reference.differences: Official UncertPred uses prior/current pixel features, prior mask, new-old values, BN and alpha-change supervision; U weights new values, whereas our g weights aligned old state

limitations: M/U are actual-component diagnostics, not official Pd/Fa.
Strict continuity covers frozen5200 annotated target frames/130 tracks, not all16297 GT or complete physical visibility.
O/S union recovery and loss can intersect; their difference is not a single-config net benefit.
Both trained arms include the original temporal frontend/TPro; Current only removes additional M1 recursive history.
No Frame-control evidence here; pixel-selective gating benefit is not established by this comparison alone.
Training calibration, larger state differences and lower background cost cannot replace actual recovery.
Native DCNv2/adaptive-pooling backward is not bitwise deterministic; one short paired run does not establish generalization.
